questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

All members of the association __adhere __to a strict code of practice.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**flout**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Here are the meanings of the words and a sentence using the correct option: 
 
 
• **Observe** (निरीक्षण करना) - to watch carefully or pay close attention to something.
 
• **Cling** (चिपटना) - to hold onto something tightly or to be unwilling to let go.
 
• **Flout** (उल्लंघन करना) - to openly disregard or disobey a rule, law, or convention.
 
• **Comply** (अनुपालन करना) - to act in accordance with a rule, request, or command. 
 
 
 
• Among these options, the most appropriate antonym of "**adhere**" in the given sentence is: **flout**.
 
• Explanation:
 
 
• "**Adhere**" in the sentence means to follow or stick to something, such as a strict code of practice.
 
• "**Flout**" is the opposite, meaning to openly disregard or disobey something, which directly contradicts the idea of adhering to a strict code of practice.
 
 
 
• ***Sentence using the correct option:**__ Despite the warnings, some companies continue to flout environmental regulations, ignoring the need to **adhere** to sustainable practices.*

questions.question:
Select the word from the sentence below, which is an antonym for the word ‘advance’.

Clive is a travel blogger who believes that with even an elementary or intermediate Knowledge of the local language, you can enjoy your travel more.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

__
 
• The word **‘elementary’ **means** basic or simple**, which is the opposite of **‘advance’** that implies progress or higher level.
 
• In the given sentence, the** context indicates a basic or initial level of knowledge, which aligns with the meaning of ‘elementary’.**
 
• Therefore,** ‘elementary’ is the correct antonym for ‘advance’ in this context.**

Hence, the correct sentence is** "*Clive is a travel blogger who believes that with even an elementary__ or intermediate knowledge of the local language, you can enjoy your travel more."***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• In general, when looking for antonyms, consider the context of the sentence to ensure the chosen word fits appropriately.
 
• Advanced knowledge would imply a higher level of understanding, whereas elementary knowledge implies a basic, foundational level.
